name: redis-js
description: Teaches coding agents how to use the Upstash Redis TypeScript SDK for serverless Redis over HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Use the Upstash Redis TypeScript SDK for serverless Redis
interface.longDescription:
Upstash Redis is a serverless Redis database accessed over HTTP. This plugin teaches coding agents how to use the @upstash/redis TypeScript SDK — initialization, auto-serialization of JavaScript types, and the skill guides already in this repository.

Use it when building caching, session storage, rate limiting, leaderboards, pipelines and transactions, Redis data structures, or full-text search with the Upstash Redis search extension. The skill points agents at practical patterns and common SDK pitfalls instead of guessing Redis APIs.

The skill text matches skills/SKILL.md and its topic guides under skills/.
defaultPrompt: Cache API responses with @upstash/redis and a short TTL
Add a sorted-set leaderboard using the Upstash Redis SDK
Query and filter documents with the Upstash Redis search extension
